Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Exec offsite — leg coverage + overnight plan

Hi Sam / TravelMate team,

Quick one as we lock the travel roster for next week's exec offsite in Portland. We have ten attendees arriving from three hubs (SFO, BOS, LHR) across two arrival days. A couple of constraints to call out:

- Two execs (Ben and Rishi) want morning arrivals on Aug 10 to join the 9am pre-brief.
- The LHR group hits late evening on Aug 9; one legs out same-night; the rest need overnight rooms.
- We want contiguous seating where possible for the SFO group (2x seats together) and aisle preference for several attendees.

Can TravelMate confirm PNRs for all legs and whether any carrier is asking for rebooking fees for the later leg swaps we've requested? Also attaching an updated manifest with seat preferences and rooming notes.

Sam — can you confirm Acme's preferred airport pickup times so we can align the shuttle?

Next steps:
- TravelMate: send final PNRs + any rebooking costs by Thursday (Aug 5).
- Acme (Sam): confirm pickup window and any exec VIPs who need a private transfer.
- Internal (Ben / Karthik / Marissa): we'll tag who handles airport meet & greet per leg.

Thanks — Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood_exec_manifest_v2.csv (roster + seat prefs), overnight-rooming-requests.xlsx
From: TravelMate <flights@travelmate.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec offsite — leg coverage + overnight plan

Hi Laura / Sam / Redwood team,

Thanks for the details — we’ve provisionally ticketed the group and attached the consolidated PNR packet (acme_group_pnrs.pdf). Highlights:

- SFO leg: two contiguous window+aisle seats confirmed on UA 238 (arrive PDX 18:20 local).
- BOS leg: one connection (BOS -> DCA -> PDX) with an overnight in DCA for passenger 7 (per their preference); no extra fee as the carrier provided a waiver.
- LHR leg: BA 87 into PDX; six passengers arrive 22:40 local. One ticket (Rishi Malhotra) was flagged as change fee eligible — we applied a change waiver courtesy of the corporate contract.

Estimated additional fees: $0 (we were able to avoid rebooking charges for the requested leg swaps).

Notes and open items:
- Please confirm who will handle late-night airport pickup on Aug 9 (PDX). Harbor Inn can hold three late check-ins with no extra charge; beyond that there will be a late arrival fee.
- We included seat maps; if any exec requires a last-minute upgrade, reply with the PNR and we'll quote the cost.

We can finalize and ticket within 24 hours once you confirm the pickup plan and the three requested aisle/window swaps for passenger IDs 4, 7, and 9.

Regards,
Elena Ortiz
TravelMate — Group Travel Desk
flights@travelmate.com
+1 (800) 555-3099

Attachment: acme_group_pnrs.pdf (PDF with PNRs and seat maps)

Laura — I can own the late-night pickup on Aug 9 (PDX). I'll coordinate with Harbor Inn ops to confirm the three late check-ins. Karthik — can you be point for the morning arrivals on Aug 10 (Ben and Rishi)?

Also: to reduce risk if there are delays, I suggest we split the shuttle runs into two windows (22:30–23:15 and 23:15–00:00) and have two volunteers at the gate. I can handle the second window.

Marissa — forwarding the manifest to you to prep name badges and a desk with bottled water for the arrivals table. I’ll add the shuttle windows next to each PNR.

-Ben

Thanks to TravelMate for avoiding rebooking fees — that helps our internal approvals. We’ve uploaded the final arrival list to the shared Drive (link below). Please proceed to ticket and send final boarding passes to all attendees and copy me.

See you in Portland — Sam
